purpose: Two side-by-side 766px beige cards (one-command conversion / add new architectures), each with a bullet list, CTA link, and a terminal-transcript photo footer; followed by one full-width panel for custom/non-standard layers.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none (global prefers-reduced-motion rule, src/index.css:80-86)

nav-810.description: Card side padding is removed (!px-0 -> min-[810px]:!px-6) and card thumbnail height grows from 314px to 492px; a hidden feature list is shown (flex) at 810px.

product-1200.description: Convert-format cards go from a single stacked column to a 2-column grid; the custom-layers callout below switches from a 3-column grid (min-[1200px]) at the follow-on strip.
